limitations.en: Virtual-register arrays use public allocation/configuration APIs and bounded modeled memories in one block. Fixed-start policies make placement deterministic, not a random-quality test. Relocation checks release through public reservations; no hidden free-list order is inferred. Bus callbacks use fixture drivers and only selected value slices/statuses. No physical DUT, HDL access or memory-walk algorithm is exercised.
limitations.ja: virtual-register配列は、同じblock内の公開allocation／configuration APIと有限model化memoryを使う。固定開始policyで配置を決定し、乱数品質は検査しない。再配置のreleaseは公開予約で検査し、内部free-list順は推測しない。bus callbackは検査系driverと選択した値slice／statusだけを使う。物理DUT、HDL access、memory-walk algorithmは実行しない。

limitations.en: Public local containers are used with explicit values and exact class handles. Specialization compatibility is checked by typed aliases, while alias mutation observes shared container storage. Out-of-range numeric reads use a two-state bit-vector type with defined zero default; object reads require null. Negative get indexes and four-state defaults are not inferred. Report probes prescribe severity/count only. Shared expected lines do not create independent tests for every observation.

limitations.en: Original endpoints generate replies and delays; those choices are fixture behavior. Nine constructors are queried on concrete types without an invalid common-base cast across reversed slave interfaces. Nested export routing preserves custom request/response types, statuses and exact handles. Failed nb_transport output is deliberately unconstrained. limitations.en: Original compatible blocking-put endpoints are used. Relationship probes enable the exact uvm_resource#(uvm_bitstream_t) setting before port construction and inspect warning/error counts without prescribing diagnostic IDs/text. Role rejection observes absence of outgoing bindings without prescribing a diagnostic or severity. Cardinality reports are isolated by separate explicit resolve calls without prescribing clients/counts/IDs/text and caught so resolved sizes remain observable; no get_if is used before elaboration. Only actionable reports count as emitted warnings; UVM_NO_ACTION internal reports are excluded.

limitations.en: Original finite sequences drive actual get handshakes; get already completes each request, so no extra item_done is called. Responses are delivered through rsp_export with IDs copied from the consumed request. Zero-capacity probes use index one, strictly greater than zero; after reenabling, three new items overwrite the two-entry window before checking it. No immediate resize-eviction rule, n-equals-capacity boundary, solver distribution or history snapshot copying is inferred. Exact handle identity and mutation are observed after traffic completes.

statement.en: lock_model recursively locks the hierarchy and builds address-map offset lookups.
statement.ja: lock_modelは階層を再帰lockし、address mapのoffset検索を構築する。

conditions.en: Use a root register at zero and a child register at offset two in a submap at sixteen.
conditions.ja: root registerを0、child registerをsubmap内2、submapを16に置く。

expected.en: Both blocks become locked and root offsets zero/eighteen return the exact local/child registers.
expected.ja: 両blockがlockされ、root offset 0／18が正確なlocal／child registerを返す。

limitations.en: Original register-model fixtures use public block/map APIs, eight-bit registers and one-byte maps. Lock probes inspect exact model flags and address lookup handles, without bus transfers, cached-query behavior while unlocked or concurrency outside the specified wait. Root listings compare fixture membership rather than global counts. Glob results use fresh queues and set membership, not iteration order; only an unambiguous single result is selected. Missing library APIs remain spec-only rather than replaced by internal state.

limitations.en: The represented type is virtual and has a pure virtual method; only concrete override types can construct instances. Singleton/name/constructor counts and exact registration are observed without static initialization order or global counts. Error cases invoke the public factory callback boundary through an isolated factory with no overrides, require an ERROR and null without prescribing message text/count, and never call a guessed callback overload. The printed abstract-object callback signature and instance-override cross-reference are inconsistent with related declarations; these tests exercise the factory boundary and documented registry operation semantics only, without resolving those textual defects or claiming human approval.

limitations.en: ID tests use actual sequencer get handshakes and rsp_export after normal build/connect, two live sequences and reversed reply order. Only public set_id_info and transaction-ID accessors are used; internal sequence-ID getters/setters are not assumed. Replies are distinct objects whose explicit payload/name survive ID copying. Reparenting uses inactive concrete sequences and installs no explicit set_depth override; fresh hierarchy results are required even after earlier observations. Exact handles and paths are checked without random IDs or arbitration order.

limitations.en: Original in-memory database/stream/recorder subclasses model callback outcomes; no files, vendor attributes, external database or HDL/DPI are involved. limitations.en: Original locked three-level register-model fixtures have concrete eight-bit mapped registers and configured dynamic virtual registers/fields. Dynamic arrays need not be implemented for logical introspection. Fresh queues and exact set membership avoid order assumptions; name conflicts exist only between local and descendant scopes, with no ambiguous same-level match. Missing, ancestor and independent-root names are excluded. Map unregister uses a separate unlocked graph and observes only map content, not removed-model lifetime, block/default-map choices or a child map back-pointer. No bus or HDL behavior is asserted.

conditions.ja: 入れ子fileをoverrideなしで始め、blockの既定を変更し、その後outerにoverrideを設定する。

expected.en: Initial defaults are RTL; all inherit GATE before overrides, and the peer later follows CPU.
expected.ja: 初期値はRTLで、override前は全fileがGATEを継承し、後でpeerはCPUに従う。

limitations.en: Symbolic strings and fresh queue membership only; no actual HDL object, DPI, bus transfer or four-state behavior is established.
limitations.ja: symbolicな文字列と新しいqueueの所属のみ。実際のHDL object、DPI、bus転送、4値の動作は示さない。

statement.en: Setting a file default makes that abstraction take precedence over farther ancestor defaults.
statement.ja: fileの既定を設定すると、そのabstractionが遠い祖先の既定より優先する。

conditions.en: Outer selects TLM and inner selects RTL before the block changes to CPU.
conditions.ja: outerでTLM、innerでRTLを設定した後、blockをCPUへ変更する。

expected.en: The resulting defaults are TLM for outer, RTL for inner and CPU for the independent peer.
expected.ja: 結果の既定はouterがTLM、innerがRTL、独立peerがCPUである。

statement.en: Full register-file paths include every tested combination of parent and local HDL alternatives.
statement.ja: register fileの完全pathは、対象の親とlocalのHDL代替pathの全組合せを含む。

conditions.en: The block, outer file and inner file each have two distinct RTL contributions.
conditions.ja: block、outer file、inner fileが、それぞれ異なる2つのRTL寄与を持つ。

expected.en: The eight full strings are exactly the two-by-two-by-two combinations; local enumeration still has two entries.
expected.ja: 完全文字列8個は2×2×2の組合せに正確に一致し、local一覧は2要素のままである。

statement.ja: HDL寄与を指定せずにconfigureしたregister fileは、子孫HDL pathへ論理名を追加しない。

expected.en: The RTL descendant path is dut.leaf with no logical-file component.
expected.ja: RTLの子孫pathはdut.leafで、論理fileの成分を含まない。

conditions.en: A flattened parent selects GATE while its child has distinct RTL leaf and GATE cell contributions.

expected.en: The explicit RTL path is dut.leaf and both selected and explicit GATE paths are net.cell; the explicit GATE query controls for path assembly.
expected.ja: 明示RTL pathはdut.leaf、選択した既定GATEと明示GATEのpathはnet.cellで、明示GATE照会をpath組立てのcontrolとする。

conditions.ja: 同じ制約の2つのFIFOをrandomizeした後、一方の先頭を99へ変える。

expected.en: The changed front is 99 while the peer still returns 17 and retains size three.
expected.ja: 変更した先頭は99で、peerは17を返しsize 3を保持する。

limitations.en: Public abstract queue, metadata and selected constraints only; no implementation-specific build, FIFO bus transfer, compare policy, prediction or DUT storage is exercised.
limitations.ja: 公開abstract queue、metadata、選択した制約のみ。実装固有build、FIFO bus転送、compare policy、prediction、DUT storageは実行しない。

expected_observations: UT: local_change front 99 peer 17 size 3 capacity 4

statement.en: A catcher helper report bypasses the entire catching callback chain.

expected_observations: UT: counts info 2 error 0 warning 0 helper 1 outer 1

statement.en: lock reports fatal when neither an explicit nor a default sequencer is available.

conditions.en: An unbound sequence calls lock without an argument after confirming a null default.

expected.en: The original report severity is UVM_FATAL.
expected.ja: 元の報告severityはUVM_FATALである。

limitations.en: The fixture deliberately terminates with its own fatal sentinel after observing severity; declared nonzero exit and fixture diagnostic are harness controls, not library exit/message requirements. No continuation after fatal is asserted.
limitations.ja: severity観測後に検査系自身のfatal sentinelで意図的に終了する。宣言したnonzero終了と検査系診断はharness制御であり、libraryの終了／文面への要求ではない。fatal後の継続は評価しない。

statement.en: Under a no-binding interpretation, a initiator terminator cannot connect to another initiator terminator.

limitations.en: Qualified no-binding interpretation: the general same-kind restriction does not specify direct provider-list state after an invalid connect. statement.en: An inherited concrete do_open_db implementation satisfies the declared pure hook and is reached through its public wrapper.
statement.ja: 継承した具象do_open_db実装は宣言されたpure hookを満たし、public wrapperから到達する。

conditions.en: Construct a leaf without overriding the parent hook bodies; use exact base views with two valid streams from the same open database and an original link.
conditions.ja: 親のhook本体をoverrideしないleafを生成し、同じopen databaseの有効stream 2つと独自linkをexact base viewで使う。

expected.en: The selected wrapper reaches the inherited hook: opening/closing succeeds, stream objects and link identity are preserved, or endpoint setters/getters each run once before database linking.
expected.ja: 選択wrapperは継承hookへ到達する。open／closeは成功し、stream objectとlink identityを保持するか、databaseでlinkする前のendpoint setter／getterが各1回動作する。

limitations.en: A legal inheritance and selected wrapper-dispatch control. Original hook payload algorithms and success responses are setup, not prescribed implementations. No combined setter order, extra getter calls during link validation, failed database operations, external backend, other stream lifecycle or all inheritance shapes are claimed.
limitations.ja: 合法な継承と選択wrapper dispatchのcontrol。独自hookのpayload algorithmと成功応答は準備であり規定実装ではない。combined setter順序、link検証時の追加getter回数、database失敗、外部backend、他stream lifecycle、全継承形状は主張しない。

expected_observations: UT: inherited_database open 1 streams 1/1 calls 1/2 link 1/1

limitations.en: Delegation through an original memory subtype only: it observes absolute location/context inputs and supplies original response/status tokens. It does not model physical storage, actual HDL force/deposit, a real bus, callback timing or successful data after a failed read. Read data is checked only on success. limitations.en: Positive time delays separate observations. The original worker and its forked descendant never raise an objection or kill themselves. conditions.en: Use the selected original hierarchical register/memory models and their explicit public calls. Named wrapper observations call through a block base view and genuine configured lookup; actual frontdoor cases use the original adapter, sequencer and driver storage.
conditions.ja: 選択した独自階層register／memoryモデルと明示公開callを使う。名前wrapper観測はblock base viewと実configure済みlookupを呼び、実frontdoor条件は独自adapter・sequencer・driver storageを使う。

expected.en: The named register write preserves the selected supplied data.
expected.ja: 名前によるregister writeは選択した指定dataを保持する。

limitations.en: Selected valid names, in-range offsets and full-width RW models only. Forwarding observers implement their own target response; they do not certify DUT transport. Separate frontdoor controls exercise inherited model operations. No missing-name behavior, invalid path/map, all topology, all policies, sibling traversal order or failed-read data is certified. Debug strings/line numbers may be forwarded or ignored; only functional invariance is required.
limitations.ja: 選択合法名、範囲内offset、全幅RWモデルだけ。転送observerは独自target応答を実装し、DUT transportを認定しない。別frontdoor controlは継承モデル操作を実行する。欠落名の動作、不正path／map、全topology、全policy、兄弟走査順、失敗read dataを認定しない。debug string／行番号は転送／無視どちらも許容し、機能不変性だけを要求する。

expected_observations: UT: named_reg_frontdoor debug 0 write 1 read 1 value 1 peer 1 address 1
UT: named_reg_frontdoor debug 1 write 1 read 1 value 1 peer 1 address 1

conditions.en: Use the selected original hierarchical register/memory models and their explicit public calls. Named wrapper observations call through a block base view and genuine configured lookup; actual frontdoor cases use the original adapter, sequencer and driver storage.
conditions.ja: 選択した独自階層register／memoryモデルと明示公開callを使う。名前wrapper観測はblock base viewと実configure済みlookupを呼び、実frontdoor条件は独自adapter・sequencer・driver storageを使う。

expected.en: The wrapper forwards omitted null or the exact supplied extension handle.
expected.ja: wrapperは省略nullまたは指定された正確なextension handleを転送する。

limitations.en: Selected valid names, in-range offsets and full-width RW models only. Forwarding observers implement their own target response; they do not certify DUT transport. Separate frontdoor controls exercise inherited model operations. No missing-name behavior, invalid path/map, all topology, all policies, sibling traversal order or failed-read data is certified. Debug strings/line numbers may be forwarded or ignored; only functional invariance is required.
limitations.ja: 選択合法名、範囲内offset、全幅RWモデルだけ。転送observerは独自target応答を実装し、DUT transportを認定しない。別frontdoor controlは継承モデル操作を実行する。欠落名の動作、不正path／map、全topology、全policy、兄弟走査順、失敗read dataを認定しない。debug string／行番号は転送／無視どちらも許容し、機能不変性だけを要求する。

limitations.en: The nested word case is a qualified literal reading: 18.2.4.6 refers to get_n_bytes without overriding its HIER default. A local configured-width interpretation is plausible and remains a review issue; do not silently replace the oracle. The flat word and byte controls are separate. No physical beat/address translation is inferred from this getter. If the effective-width query also differs, the numeric word-unit difference alone does not isolate a separate unit defect.
limitations.ja: 入れ子word条件は限定した字面の読み方で、18.2.4.6はHIER既定値を変更せずget_n_bytesを参照する。local設定幅の解釈もあり得るため照合課題を保持し、黙ってoracleを置換しない。平坦wordとbyteのcontrolは別で、このgetterから物理beat／address変換を導かない。 有効幅照会も異なる場合、数値のword単位差分だけで独立した単位の欠陥を特定しない。

expected_observations: UT: map_unit byte 1 flat_word 8 local_word_width 8 effective_width 2

expected.en: Under the printed get_n_bytes reference and its declared HIER default, the selected word-addressed map reports that effective width as its addressable unit.

limitations.en: The nested word case is a qualified literal reading: 18.2.4.6 refers to get_n_bytes without overriding its HIER default. A local configured-width interpretation is plausible and remains a review issue; do not silently replace the oracle. The flat word and byte controls are separate. No physical beat/address translation is inferred from this getter. If the effective-width query also differs, the numeric word-unit difference alone does not isolate a separate unit defect.
limitations.ja: 入れ子word条件は限定した字面の読み方で、18.2.4.6はHIER既定値を変更せずget_n_bytesを参照する。local設定幅の解釈もあり得るため照合課題を保持し、黙ってoracleを置換しない。平坦wordとbyteのcontrolは別で、このgetterから物理beat／address変換を導かない。 有効幅照会も異なる場合、数値のword単位差分だけで独立した単位の欠陥を特定しない。

conditions.en: One original three-level hierarchy contains same-name distinct registers, memories and implemented virtual registers. Each physical register has two fields; each virtual register has one field. An alternative map of the same root block owns separate contents and is not a submap. All output queues start empty.
conditions.ja: 独自3階層には同名だが別handleのregister、memory、実装済みvirtual registerを置く。各物理registerは2 field、各virtual registerは1 fieldを持つ。同じroot blockの別mapは別の内容を持ち、submapではない。出力queueは全て空で始める。

expected.en: NO_HIER get_submaps returns the selected directly instantiated map members.
expected.ja: NO_HIER get_submapsは選択した直接のmap memberを返す。

limitations.en: Handle sets and exact selected counts, with no iteration order. Count plus a complete handle bitset rules out selected duplicates/foreign members. The cases do not establish all topology, prepopulated queue behavior, detached/unregistered state or runtime transfer through every member. A missing getter remains an unexecuted build difference with its independent oracle unchanged.
limitations.ja: 反復順を課さずhandle集合と選択した正確な件数を使う。件数と全handle bitsetで選択重複／外部memberを排除する。全topology、内容のあるqueue、切離し／登録解除状態、全memberの実行時転送は立証しない。getter欠落は独立oracleを変えず未実行build差分に残す。

statement.en: HIER get_submaps recursively includes the selected descendants.
statement.ja: HIER get_submapsは選択した子孫を再帰的に含める。

statement.en: Memory lookup in selected byte units returns the same memory for first, interior and last occupied locations.
statement.ja: 選択byte単位のmemory lookupは先頭・内部・最後の占有locationで同じmemoryを返す。

conditions.en: Locked zero-base maps avoid conflating the offset contract with external-base wording. Byte addressing uses four 16-bit entries on a one-byte bus; word addressing uses three 64-bit entries on a four-byte bus. A separate map contains a different memory at the same offset.
conditions.ja: lock済みbase 0 mapを使い、offset契約とexternal-base文言を混同しない。byte addressingは1-byte bus上の16-bit 4 entry、word addressingは4-byte bus上の64-bit 3 entryを使う。別mapには同offsetの別memoryを置く。

expected.en: Memory lookup in selected byte units returns the same memory for first, interior and last occupied locations.
expected.ja: 選択byte単位のmemory lookupは先頭・内部・最後の占有locationで同じmemoryを返す。

limitations.en: Selected contiguous aligned full-beat ranges and explicit known empty neighboring addresses. No root-base ambiguity, all partial-byte layouts, overlapping physical memories, unaligned mapping, invalid ownership or actual memory bus transfer is certified.
limitations.ja: 選択した連続・整列・全beat範囲と、空と分かる隣接addressだけ。root-baseの曖昧さ、全端数byte layout、重複物理memory、非整列map、不正所有、実memory bus転送は認定しない。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values, widths up to 53 bits, valid ownership and explicit map conditions only. Do not infer all reverse-map cache updates, already-absent removal, re-registration, destruction, arbitrary topology or concurrent structural mutation. Symbolic HDL presence is not a path-string or physical transport certificate. Availability metadata is not measured covergroup coverage.

conditions.en: Two original full-width 16-bit RW register models have two eight-bit fields each. Selected HARD/SOFT definitions, model predictions and desired values are set explicitly; the any-field case deliberately omits one HARD field reset. No physical access is performed by these metadata fixtures.

expected.ja: get_resetは選択low／high field reset値をregister値へ合成する。

limitations.en: Selected full-width RW fields and reset causes only. Missing reset values are not assigned an arbitrary assembled reset oracle. No physical DUT reset, semaphore recovery, write-once rearming, every field policy or concurrent reset is certified.
limitations.ja: 選択全幅RW fieldとreset原因だけ。reset欠落に任意の合成reset期待値を課さない。物理DUT reset、semaphore回復、write-once再有効化、全field policy、並行resetは認定しない。

statement.ja: runより前のcommon phaseは時刻0で実行する。

conditions.en: Four overridden common hooks execute through the real phase engine.
conditions.ja: 4個のoverrideしたcommon hookを実phase engineで実行する。

expected.en: All four hooks are observed and all their time samples are zero.
expected.ja: 4 hook全てを観測し、その時刻sampleが全て0となる。

limitations.en: One test component; broader hierarchy traversal and user extension timing remain separate.
limitations.ja: 1 test componentのみ。広い階層走査やuser拡張timingは別に残る。

statement.en: The run phase begins at simulation time zero.
statement.ja: run phaseはsimulation時刻0で開始する。

conditions.en: A phase-start callback observes run before an objection-held three-unit task.
conditions.ja: phase-start callbackがobjectionで保持する3単位taskの前にrunを観測する。

expected.en: run_start_zero is true.
expected.ja: run_start_zeroが真となる。

limitations.en: One normal run; restart, global timeout and alternate domains are separate conditions.
limitations.ja: 通常run 1回のみ。再開、global timeout、別domainは別条件とする。

statement.en: The end of run has the same simulation time as final completion.
statement.ja: runの終了とfinal完了は同じsimulation時刻を持つ。

conditions.en: An objection holds run for positive time; its ended callback records time and final samples it.
conditions.ja: objectionがrunを正の時間保持し、ended callbackが記録した時刻をfinalが照会する。

expected.en: Run has ended, its end time equals final time and duration is positive.
expected.ja: runが終了し、その終了時刻がfinal時刻と等しく、継続時間が正となる。

limitations.en: A function final cannot consume time; this selected endpoint equality does not establish every run-thread lifetime or all concurrent branch conditions.
limitations.ja: function finalは時間を消費できず、この限定した終了時刻の一致で全run thread寿命や全並行分岐条件は認定しない。

statement.en: The predefined runtime phases follow their default execution order.
statement.ja: 定義済みruntime phaseは既定の実行順序に従う。

conditions.en: One real default domain executes all twelve hooks, each held by an objection for two positive delay units.
conditions.ja: 1つの実既定domainが12 hookを実行し、各々をobjectionで正の2遅延単位保持する。

expected.en: All twelve starts and ends occur in order.
expected.ja: 12個全ての開始と終了が順序どおりに現れる。

limitations.en: No inserted phases, multiple domains or simultaneous participants in this fixture; common concurrency is an independently linked observation.
limitations.ja: このfixtureにはphase挿入、複数domain、同時参加componentはなく、common並行性は独立した対応観測とする。

statement.en: The runtime schedule runs concurrently with the common run phase.
statement.ja: runtime scheduleはcommon run phaseと並行に動く。

conditions.en: The common run node is captured and its original task advances a heartbeat every unit; all twelve runtime tasks sample it two positive units apart.
conditions.ja: common run nodeを取得し、独自taskが1単位ごとにheartbeatを進め、12 runtime taskが正の2単位間隔で照会する。

statement.en: Expiration of the run-phase timeout reports FATAL.
statement.ja: run phaseのtimeout満了はFATALを報告する。

conditions.en: Before run starts, the global limit is locked at five and a task holds an objection beyond it.
conditions.ja: run開始前にglobal上限を5でlockし、taskがそれを超えてobjectionを保持する。

expected.en: The catcher observes FATAL at the configured absolute time.
expected.ja: catcherが設定した絶対時刻でFATALを観測する。

limitations.en: No report ID/text/default implementation timeout is prescribed. The printed F.7.2.3 cross-reference differs from the actual set_timeout heading F.7.3.3, used here.
limitations.ja: report ID／文面／実装既定timeoutは規定しない。印字の参照F.7.2.3は実際のset_timeout見出しF.7.3.3と異なるため後者を使う。

statement.en: A non-overridable timeout ignores subsequent replacement calls.
statement.ja: override不可のtimeoutは後続の置換呼出しを無効にする。

conditions.en: set_timeout(5,0) is followed by set_timeout(30,1) before run.
conditions.ja: run前にset_timeout(5,0)の後でset_timeout(30,1)を呼ぶ。

expected.en: The fatal timeout is still observed at five.
expected.ja: fatal timeoutは5で観測される。

limitations.en: One increasing replacement and an absolute time origin of zero; no exact warning or report ID is required.
limitations.ja: 増加方向の置換1回と絶対時刻の起点0のみ。正確なwarningやreport IDは要求しない。

statement.en: The timeout overridable argument defaults to enabled.
statement.ja: timeoutのoverridable引数の既定値は有効である。

conditions.en: Calls omitting the second argument change the limit from five to twenty; the real run completes at eight.
conditions.ja: 第2引数を省略した呼出しで上限を5から20へ変え、実runを8で完了する。

expected.en: Execution crosses the former limit, completes and remains before the replacement limit.
expected.ja: 以前の上限を超えて実行し、完了時も置換した上限より前である。

limitations.en: One increasing replacement, no boundary-equality claim and no assumption about the implementation-specific initial timeout.
limitations.ja: 増加方向の置換1回のみ。等号境界は認定せず、実装依存の初期timeoutは仮定しない。

statement.en: A custom phase can specialize its proxy for an extended component hook while retaining a homogeneous phase base.
statement.ja: 独自phaseは共通phase基底を保持しつつ、拡張component hook用にproxyを特化できる。

conditions.en: Two original component subtypes use parameterized singleton proxies through top-down base views and separate graph nodes.
conditions.ja: 2つの独自component subtypeがtop-down基底viewと別々のgraph node経由でparameter化singleton proxyを使う。

expected.en: Each extended hook is called once with its context, the per-type singleton is reused and the two proxy types/nodes are distinct.
expected.ja: 各拡張hookがcontext付きで1回呼ばれ、型ごとのsingletonを再利用し、2 proxy型／nodeは別となる。

limitations.en: The custom hooks are original setup, not a prescribed data algorithm; invalid component casts and all user extension shapes remain separate.
limitations.ja: 独自hookは設定であり規定data algorithmではない。不正component castと全user拡張形状は別に残す。

statement.en: A selected phase synchronizes with the same phase in the target domain when with_phase is omitted.
statement.ja: with_phase省略時、選択phaseはtarget domain内の同じphaseと同期する。

conditions.en: Two assigned domains execute original workers with unequal positive pre-reset/reset/main delays.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainが異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main遅延を持つ独自workerを実行する。

expected.en: main starts and ends together despite unequal predecessor/body delays; reset remains independent.
expected.ja: 先行処理とbody遅延が異なってもmainの開始／終了が揃い、resetは独立を保つ。

limitations.en: One main pair; this does not certify every synchronization topology.
limitations.ja: main 1組のみ。全同期topologyは認定しない。

statement.en: Omitting phase adds domain synchronization relationships, including the selected reset and post-main controls.
statement.ja: phase省略はdomain間の同期関係を追加し、選択resetとpost-main controlも含む。

conditions.en: Two assigned domains execute original workers with unequal positive pre-reset/reset/main delays.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainが異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main遅延を持つ独自workerを実行する。

expected.en: After removing main alone, reset endpoints and post-main starts still agree.
expected.ja: mainだけを除去した後もresetの両端とpost-main開始が一致する。

limitations.en: Selected retained controls only, not observations of every built-in phase pair.
limitations.ja: 保持した選択controlのみで、全built-in phase組を観測したものではない。

statement.en: with_phase may synchronize different phases across domains.
statement.ja: with_phaseはdomainをまたぐ異なるphaseを同期できる。

conditions.en: Two assigned domains execute original workers with unequal positive pre-reset/reset/main delays.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainが異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main遅延を持つ独自workerを実行する。

expected.en: A main and B reset start/end together; B main follows its reset.
expected.ja: AのmainとBのresetの開始／終了が揃い、Bのmainはresetに続く。

limitations.en: One main/reset pair without cyclic dependencies or invalid nodes.
limitations.ja: 循環依存や不正nodeのないmain／reset 1組のみ。

statement.en: Removing a selected same-name phase relationship leaves other domain relationships in place.
statement.ja: 選択した同名phase関係の解除は他のdomain関係を保持する。

conditions.en: Two assigned domains execute original workers with unequal positive pre-reset/reset/main delays.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainが異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main遅延を持つ独自workerを実行する。

expected.en: main ends become independent while reset endpoints and the later join remain synchronized.
expected.ja: main終了は独立になり、reset両端と後続joinは同期を保つ。

limitations.en: Removal before execution, not mutation of an active synchronization relation.
limitations.ja: 実行前の解除であり、実行中同期関係の変更ではない。

statement.en: Omitting phase removes domain synchronization relationships.
statement.ja: phase省略はdomain間の同期関係を解除する。

conditions.en: Two assigned domains execute original workers with unequal positive pre-reset/reset/main delays.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainが異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main遅延を持つ独自workerを実行する。

expected.en: Unequal delays produce independent main starts/ends and simultaneous distinct node states.
expected.ja: 異なる遅延によってmainの開始／終了が独立し、同時にnode状態が異なる。

limitations.en: Selected main observations, not every phase endpoint or active mutation.
limitations.ja: 選択mainの観測のみ。全phaseの両端や実行中の変更ではない。

statement.en: An explicit different-phase relationship can be removed with the same phase pair.
statement.ja: 異なるphaseの明示関係は同じphase組を指定して解除できる。

conditions.en: Two assigned domains execute original workers with unequal positive pre-reset/reset/main delays.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainが異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main遅延を持つ独自workerを実行する。

expected.en: Independent main progress and distinct simultaneous node states return after removal.
expected.ja: 解除後にmainの独立進行と同時に異なるnode状態が戻る。

limitations.en: One main/reset pair configured before run; no all-topology guarantee.
limitations.ja: run前に設定したmain／reset 1組のみで、全topologyの保証ではない。

statement.en: Separate domains can advance their phase schedules independently.
statement.ja: 別々のdomainはphase scheduleを独立して進行できる。

conditions.en: Two newly assigned domains run different positive pre-reset/reset/main durations without adding synchronization.
conditions.ja: 新しく割当てた2 domainを同期追加なしで異なる正のpre-reset／reset／main時間で動かす。

expected.en: A enters and ends main earlier than B, with one call per worker and retained domain assignments.
expected.ja: AがBより先にmainへ入り終了し、各worker 1回の呼出しとdomain割当てを保持する。

limitations.en: Two domains and selected runtime phases only; common-phase synchronization, every graph shape and all simultaneous state transitions remain separate.
limitations.ja: 2 domainと選択runtime phaseのみ。common phase同期、全graph形状、全同時state遷移は別に残る。

statement.en: Graph nodes sharing a phase implementation retain independent execution state.
statement.ja: phase implementationを共有するgraph nodeは独立した実行stateを持つ。

conditions.en: The actual main nodes in two assigned domains are compared during A main before B main starts.
conditions.ja: 割当てた2 domainの実main nodeを、B main開始前のA main中に比較する。

expected.en: Distinct nodes simultaneously show A EXECUTING and B not EXECUTING.
expected.ja: 別々のnodeが同時にAはEXECUTING、BはEXECUTING以外となる。

limitations.en: One simultaneous state observation, without assuming the other node's exact dormant/scheduled value or all interleavings.
limitations.ja: 同時stateの観測1回のみ。他nodeの正確なdormant／scheduled値や全interleavingは仮定しない。

statement.en: A domain jump to a shared predecessor affects both active related branches.
statement.ja: 共通先行nodeへのdomain jumpは両方の関連active分岐に作用する。

conditions.en: An original schedule forks two active task phases with a shared predecessor and successor; the common run controller jumps to the predecessor.
conditions.ja: 独自scheduleが共通先行／後続nodeを持つ2 active task phaseへ分岐し、common run controllerが先行nodeへjumpする。

expected.en: The predecessor and both branches execute twice, the join once, and an independent peer completes once.

expected.en: The two-slice local path retains high56 at 8/8 and low56 at 0/8.
expected.ja: 2-slice local pathはhigh56の8／8とlow56の0／8を保持する。

limitations.ja: path文字列と座標のみで、storage access、slice packing、一般HDL backend supportを認定しない。

statement.en: The first flag starts a duplicate memory HDL implementation.
statement.ja: first flagは重複memory HDL implementationを開始する。

conditions.en: Add a two-slice RTL concatenation, then a whole-variable slice with first explicitly true.
conditions.ja: 2-slice RTL concatを追加した後、firstを明示trueにした全変数sliceを追加する。

expected.en: A whole-variable copy56 with -1/-1 coordinates is a second concatenation rather than a third slice in the first.
expected.ja: -1／-1座標の全変数copy56は、最初の3番目sliceでなく2番目concatとなる。

limitations.en: Path strings and coordinates only; these observations do not certify storage access, slice packing or general HDL backend support.
limitations.ja: path文字列と座標のみで、storage access、slice packing、一般HDL backend supportを認定しない。

conditions.ja: rootとchildが各2個のRTL incremental pathを持ち、memoryはcells56 pathを1個持つ。照会は明示RTLとslash separatorを使う。

expected.en: The four distinct ancestor cross-product strings appear once each with whole-variable slice coordinates unchanged.
expected.ja: ancestor直積の異なる文字列4個がそれぞれ1回現れ、全変数slice座標を保持する。

statement.en: The memory coverage builder returns requested models selected by include_coverage resources.
statement.ja: memory coverage builderはinclude_coverage resourceで選択した要求modelを返す。

conditions.en: Configured sibling memories use exact hierarchical include scopes; an original public wrapper calls the protected nonvirtual builder after configuration.
conditions.ja: configureした兄弟memoryが正確な階層include scopeを使い、独自公開wrapperがconfigure後にprotected nonvirtual builderを呼ぶ。

expected.en: The selected memory returns the selected union and requested intersection; the explicitly excluded sibling returns no models.
expected.ja: 選択memoryは選択和集合と要求との積集合を返し、明示除外した兄弟はmodelを返さない。

limitations.en: Coverage availability metadata only, not actual covergroups/bins, constructor-time name resolution, wildcard precedence or all resources. No memory-specific include_coverage API is invented.
limitations.ja: coverage availability metadataのみで、実covergroup／bin、constructor時の名前解決、wildcard優先順位、全resourceではない。memory固有include_coverage APIは作らない。

statement.en: A subsequently derived memory constructor can add available coverage models.
statement.ja: 後続の派生memory constructorは利用可能coverage modelを追加できる。

conditions.en: Base construction supplies REG_BITS; only the derived constructor calls add_coverage with ADDR_MAP.
conditions.ja: 基底生成がREG_BITSを供給し、派生constructorだけがADDR_MAPを指定してadd_coverageを呼ぶ。

expected.en: Both models and their union are available; FIELD_VALS remains absent; enabling all models and then ADDR_MAP gates unavailable models and returns the previous mask.
expected.ja: 両modelと和集合が利用可能となり、FIELD_VALSは不在を保つ。全model、次にADDR_MAPを有効化すると、利用不可modelを抑制し、以前のmaskを返す。

limitations.en: Only legal constructor use is exercised; no invented diagnostic for calls from other contexts. These are control bits, not measured functional coverage.
limitations.ja: 合法constructor利用のみを動かし、他contextからの呼出しについて診断を作らない。これらは制御bitで、測定したfunctional coverageではない。

expected_observations: UT: added_models base 1 extra 1 union 1 unavailable 1

statement.en: The omitted zero-time relevance maximum is ten.

conditions.ja: setterを呼ばず、時刻0で常にirrelevantな1 sequenceが時間を進めずwait_for_relevantから戻る。

expected.ja: 選択境界で同じsimulation時刻にerrorを観測し、fallback、grant、driver受信はなく、独自override回数は呼出経路と一致する。

limitations.en: The selected reading accepts an ERROR or FATAL notification at the bound or first excess, before time advances; this is not a severity/ID/text/count mandate. No exact private counter, negative/zero bound, mid-burst reset or recovery contract is invented. The original callback blocks after notification/fallback, and the owner terminates pending work without a recovery assertion.
limitations.ja: 選択解釈は上限または最初の超過で時間が進む前のERROR／FATAL通知を許容し、severity／ID／文面／回数の指定ではない。正確なprivate counter、負／0上限、途中reset、復旧契約を作らない。独自callbackは通知／fallback後にblockし、ownerが復旧を主張せず保留処理を終了する。

expected.ja: typed readは初期／置換対象を保持し、独立peerは未変更で、sequence実行なしでnullを保存できる。

limitations.en: This verifies declared handle storage, replacement and instance isolation, not successful execution with a null target, clone/ownership behavior or all model hierarchies. No unspecified initial property value is asserted. Existing algorithm fixtures remain separate evidence.
limitations.ja: 宣言handleの保存、置換、instance独立性を検査し、null対象での実行成功、clone／所有動作、全model階層ではない。未規定の初期property値を主張せず、既存algorithm fixtureは別の証拠に残す。

statement.en: uvm_reg_single_access_seq construction retains its listed default name and explicit names.

conditions.en: Call the actual constructor with omitted, explicit nonempty and explicit empty names; the virtual dispatcher uses two direct original extensions to isolate omitted/explicit base calls.

expected.en: Default and explicit names match and separately created objects have distinct handles.
expected.ja: 既定／明示名が一致し、別々に生成したobjectは異なるhandleを持つ。

limitations.en: Construction only; no default body, random seed identity, factory creation or implicit generated full-name convention is assessed.
limitations.ja: 生成のみで、既定body、乱数seed同一性、factory生成、暗黙の生成full-name慣例は評価しない。

expected_observations: UT: builtin_ancestry typed 1 sequence 1 object 1 distinct 1

conditions.en: Original concrete target objects are assigned/read through the builtin property, with separate sequence instances and static receiver types.
conditions.ja: 独自具象target objectをbuiltin property経由で代入／readし、別sequence instanceとstatic receiver型を使う。

expected.en: Typed reads retain initial/replacement targets, an independent peer stays unchanged and null can be stored without executing the sequence.
expected.ja: typed readは初期／置換対象を保持し、独立peerは未変更で、sequence実行なしでnullを保存できる。

limitations.en: This verifies declared handle storage, replacement and instance isolation, not successful execution with a null target, clone/ownership behavior or all model hierarchies. No unspecified initial property value is asserted. Existing algorithm fixtures remain separate evidence.
limitations.ja: 宣言handleの保存、置換、instance独立性を検査し、null対象での実行成功、clone／所有動作、全model階層ではない。未規定の初期property値を主張せず、既存algorithm fixtureは別の証拠に残す。

statement.en: uvm_mem_single_walk_seq construction retains its listed default name and explicit names.
statement.ja: uvm_mem_single_walk_seqの生成は記載された既定名と明示名を保持する。

conditions.en: Call the actual constructor with omitted, explicit nonempty and explicit empty names; the virtual dispatcher uses two direct original extensions to isolate omitted/explicit base calls.
conditions.ja: 実constructorへ省略、明示非空、明示空の名前を渡す。virtual dispatcherは2つの独自直接拡張で省略／明示base呼出しを分離する。

expected.en: Default and explicit names match and separately created objects have distinct handles.
expected.ja: 既定／明示名が一致し、別々に生成したobjectは異なるhandleを持つ。

limitations.en: Construction only; no default body, random seed identity, factory creation or implicit generated full-name convention is assessed.
limitations.ja: 生成のみで、既定body、乱数seed同一性、factory生成、暗黙の生成full-name慣例は評価しない。

expected_observations: UT: builtin_ancestry typed 1 sequence 1 object 1 distinct 1

statement.en: uvm_mem_single_walk_seq has the declared register-sequence base specialization.
statement.ja: uvm_mem_single_walk_seqは宣言されたregister-sequence base特殊化を持つ。

conditions.en: Use implicit assignments through uvm_reg_sequence#(uvm_sequence#(uvm_reg_item)), its selected sequence base and uvm_object, without casts.
conditions.ja: castなしでuvm_reg_sequence#(uvm_sequence#(uvm_reg_item))、選択sequence base、uvm_objectへ暗黙代入する。

expected.en: All static receivers compile and retain the same original handle.
expected.ja: 全static receiverがcompileでき、同じ元handleを保持する。

limitations.en: Exact declared base specialization and selected identity relationships only. No every-builtin factory registry, type_id, macro expansion or execution algorithm is inferred. The virtual dispatcher uses concrete original extensions; its separate direct-construction negative assesses abstractness.
limitations.ja: 正確な宣言base特殊化と選択した同一性関係のみ。全builtinのfactory registry、type_id、macro展開、実行algorithmを推測しない。virtual dispatcherには独自具象拡張を使い、別の直接生成negativeで抽象性を評価する。

expected_observations: UT: builtin_ancestry typed 1 sequence 1 object 1 distinct 1

statement.en: The protected reg_seq slot stores a uvm_reg_single_bit_bash_seq handle for the selected wrapper.
statement.ja: 選択wrapperのprotected reg_seq slotはuvm_reg_single_bit_bash_seq handleを保存する。

conditions.en: Original derived accessors use the literal prototype member name and exact child type, assign/replace/clear the selected slot and capture a peer baseline; separate original factory children audit live routing.
conditions.ja: 独自派生accessorはprototypeのliteral member名と正確なchild型を使い、選択slotを代入／置換／clearしてpeer基準値を保存する。別の独自factory childは実行中の経路を監査する。

expected.en: Selected storage matches, the prior child remains valid and the peer remains unchanged; live probes require the declared slot to identify the executing child and selected targets.
expected.ja: 選択storageが一致し、前のchildも有効でpeerは未変更となる。実行中probeは宣言slotが実行childと選択対象を示すことを要求する。

limitations.en: The req_seq headings print reg_seq in their prototypes; the literal prototype is used and the naming conflict retained. No default child value, post-body retention, allocation count, sibling order or builtin payload algorithm is certified by original child bodies.
limitations.ja: req_seq見出しのprototypeはreg_seqを印字するため、literal prototypeを使い、命名矛盾を保持する。既定child値、body後の保持、割当回数、兄弟順序、独自child bodyによるbuiltin payload algorithmは認定しない。

expected_observations: UT: live_register_slot agrees 1 both_targets 1 no_foreign_target 1 delayed 1

statement.en: Direct construction of the printed virtual builtin dispatcher is illegal.
statement.ja: 印字されたvirtual builtin dispatcherの直接生成は不正である。

conditions.en: One minimal illegal declaration or external member access is isolated; a separate original legal extension is the control.
conditions.ja: 最小の不正宣言または外部member accessを分離し、別の独自合法拡張をcontrolとする。

expected.en: Compilation rejects the named fixture/type/member using the declared semantic diagnostic predicate; no runtime seed is executed, including illegal acceptance.
expected.ja: 宣言した意味診断predicateにより指定fixture／type／memberをcompilerが拒否し、不正受理でもruntime seedを実行しない。

limitations.en: A legal subclass does not replace the direct-construction rejection duty. Any concrete implementation acceptance remains a known compile result without execution.
limitations.ja: 合法subclassは直接生成拒否義務の代わりではない。具象実装による受理は実行なしの既知compile結果に残す。

expected_observations: UT: builtin_ancestry typed 1 sequence 1 object 1 distinct 1

statement.en: The virtual compare hook receives the selected rhs and comparer.
statement.ja: virtual compare hookは選択rhsとcomparerを受け取る。

conditions.en: Use same-type original objects and compare equal then unequal eight-bit values through a base view. An additional fixture alternates strict and high-nibble-mask comparer subtypes A/B/A between prints on payloads A5/A6 hexadecimal.
conditions.ja: 同型独自objectを使い、base viewで等値／非等値8 bit値を比較する。 追加検査系は16進payload A5／A6で、printの間に厳密比較と上位nibble mask比較の派生型A／B／Aを切り替える。

expected.ja: 2 hook呼出しは同じpolicyを保持し、等値／非等値結果を返す。 追加hookは各comparerの同一性を保持し、他observerが未実行でpayloadを変えずに0／1／0を返す。

expected.en: The queue retains 0x11 then 0x22.
expected.ja: queueは0x11、0x22の順に保持する。

limitations.en: Use the listed constructor/configure and public queue/APIs only, with no unlisted build hook, private field access or replacement prediction body. Original driver storage is a testbench DUT model, not RTL or HDL-DPI. The independent normal-register bus control is separate evidence; a blocked FIFO input does not pass through that control. Broader constructor/precondition interpretation, failure, capacity/width, backdoor and concurrent histories remain partial. Separately indexed control-only inputs explicitly call the pinned library build extension; they do not replace the listed-API constructor premise or pass its blocked direct inputs.

conditions.en: Use the original one-byte bus FIFO model and independent register control, explicit frontdoor/map and selected auto/external prediction. Preload update occurs before any blocking statement after set.
conditions.ja: 独自1-byte bus FIFO modelと独立register control、明示frontdoor／map、選択auto／外部予測を使う。preload updateはset後のblocking文より前に行う。

expected.en: Two completed set/update pairs leave the original DUT and abstract queues as 0x11,0x22 with two writes.
expected.ja: 完了したset／update 2組は元DUT／abstract queueを0x11、0x22とし、writeは2回となる。

limitations.en: Use the listed constructor/configure and public queue/APIs only, with no unlisted build hook, private field access or replacement prediction body. Original driver storage is a testbench DUT model, not RTL or HDL-DPI. The independent normal-register bus control is separate evidence; a blocked FIFO input does not pass through that control. Broader constructor/precondition interpretation, failure, capacity/width, backdoor and concurrent histories remain partial. Separately indexed control-only inputs explicitly call the pinned library build extension; they do not replace the listed-API constructor premise or pass its blocked direct inputs.
limitations.ja: 記載constructor／configureと公開queue／APIだけを使い、記載外build hook、private field access、代用prediction本体は使わない。独自driver storageは検査系DUT modelでRTL／HDL-DPIではない。独立した通常register bus controlは別の証拠で、停止したFIFO入力をそのcontrolでpassにしない。広いconstructor／前提の解釈、失敗、容量／幅、backdoor、並行履歴は部分的に残る。 別索引のcontrol専用入力は固定libraryのbuild拡張を明示呼出しし、記載APIだけのconstructor前提を置換せず、その停止した直接入力をpassにしない。

conditions.en: Prepare matching one-entry abstract/original-DUT queues, enable both comparison controls and perform one frontdoor mirror. The public FIFO queue is primed directly, without an internal field-mirror accessor.
conditions.ja: 一致する1-entry abstract／独自DUT queueを準備し、両比較制御を有効にしてfrontdoor mirrorを1回行う。 内部field-mirror accessorを使わず、公開FIFO queueを直接準備する。

expected.en: Successful mirror reports no error and leaves both queues empty.
expected.ja: 成功mirrorはerrorを報告せず、両queueを空にする。

statement.en: The selected int scalar field macro copies its selected values and collection shape.

conditions.en: An original class declares one int scalar property with COPY and COMPARE flags and no do-copy/compare implementation. Values, sparse keys or two selected elements are initialized independently; the destination may contain stale entries. An unregistered peer differs between source and target.
conditions.ja: 独自classはintのscalar property 1個をCOPY／COMPARE flagで宣言し、do-copy／compareを実装しない。値、疎なkeyまたは選択2要素を独立に初期化し、宛先には古いentryがあり得る。未登録peerはsourceとtargetで異なる。

expected.en: The destination has exactly the selected values and shape, including the chosen high bits or signed/wide key membership; stale associative entries disappear where applicable.
expected.ja: 宛先は選択値と形状を正確に保持し、選択high bitまたはsigned／wide key所属を含む。該当時は古い連想entryがなくなる。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values and one-dimensional shapes only. Packing, printing, recording, configuration, all empty/invalid shapes, alias graphs and concurrent mutation remain partial. Copy and comparison observations share one fixture and are not independent test counts.
limitations.ja: 選択two-state値と1次元形状だけ。pack、print、record、configuration、全empty／invalid形状、alias graph、並行変更は部分的に残る。copyと比較観測は1 fixtureを共有し独立テスト数ではない。

statement.en: The selected int scalar field macro compares copied equal data successfully.
statement.ja: 選択int scalar field macroはcopy後の等値dataを等しいと比較する。

conditions.en: An original class declares one int scalar property with COPY and COMPARE flags and no do-copy/compare implementation. Values, sparse keys or two selected elements are initialized independently; the destination may contain stale entries. An unregistered peer differs between source and target.
conditions.ja: 独自classはintのscalar property 1個をCOPY／COMPARE flagで宣言し、do-copy／compareを実装しない。値、疎なkeyまたは選択2要素を独立に初期化し、宛先には古いentryがあり得る。未登録peerはsourceとtargetで異なる。

expected.en: The copied source/target compare equal despite their different unregistered peer property.
expected.ja: 未登録peer propertyが異なってもcopy後のsource／targetは等しいと比較する。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values and one-dimensional shapes only. Packing, printing, recording, configuration, all empty/invalid shapes, alias graphs and concurrent mutation remain partial. Copy and comparison observations share one fixture and are not independent test counts.
limitations.ja: 選択two-state値と1次元形状だけ。pack、print、record、configuration、全empty／invalid形状、alias graph、並行変更は部分的に残る。copyと比較観測は1 fixtureを共有し独立テスト数ではない。

expected_observations: UT: macro_compare equal 1 changed 0 source 1 peer 1

conditions.en: An original class declares one object array property with COPY and COMPARE flags and no do-copy/compare implementation. Values, sparse keys or two selected elements are initialized independently; the destination may contain stale entries. An unregistered peer differs between source and target.
conditions.ja: 独自classはobjectのarray property 1個をCOPY／COMPARE flagで宣言し、do-copy／compareを実装しない。値、疎なkeyまたは選択2要素を独立に初期化し、宛先には古いentryがあり得る。未登録peerはsourceとtargetで異なる。

expected.en: Copied child handles are distinct from source handles, retain their payloads and permit target mutation without changing the source.
expected.ja: copy後のchild handleはsourceと別でpayloadを保持し、target変更でsourceを変えない。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values and one-dimensional shapes only. Packing, printing, recording, configuration, all empty/invalid shapes, alias graphs and concurrent mutation remain partial. Copy and comparison observations share one fixture and are not independent test counts.
limitations.ja: 選択two-state値と1次元形状だけ。pack、print、record、configuration、全empty／invalid形状、alias graph、並行変更は部分的に残る。copyと比較観測は1 fixtureを共有し独立テスト数ではない。

expected_observations: UT: macro_compare equal 1 changed 0 source 1 peer 1

statement.en: The selected string array field macro copies its selected values and collection shape.
statement.ja: 選択string array field macroは選択値とcollection形状をcopyする。

conditions.en: An original class declares one string array property with COPY and COMPARE flags and no do-copy/compare implementation. Values, sparse keys or two selected elements are initialized independently; the destination may contain stale entries. An unregistered peer differs between source and target.
conditions.ja: 独自classはstringのarray property 1個をCOPY／COMPARE flagで宣言し、do-copy／compareを実装しない。値、疎なkeyまたは選択2要素を独立に初期化し、宛先には古いentryがあり得る。未登録peerはsourceとtargetで異なる。

expected.en: The destination has exactly the selected values and shape, including the chosen high bits or signed/wide key membership; stale associative entries disappear where applicable.
expected.ja: 宛先は選択値と形状を正確に保持し、選択high bitまたはsigned／wide key所属を含む。該当時は古い連想entryがなくなる。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values and one-dimensional shapes only. Packing, printing, recording, configuration, all empty/invalid shapes, alias graphs and concurrent mutation remain partial. Copy and comparison observations share one fixture and are not independent test counts.

statement.en: The selected string array field macro compares copied equal data successfully.
statement.ja: 選択string array field macroはcopy後の等値dataを等しいと比較する。

conditions.en: An original class declares one string array property with COPY and COMPARE flags and no do-copy/compare implementation. expected.en: The copied source/target compare equal despite their different unregistered peer property.

conditions.ja: 独自classはintのaa_integral property 1個をCOPY／COMPARE flagで宣言し、do-copy／compareを実装しない。値、疎なkeyまたは選択2要素を独立に初期化し、宛先には古いentryがあり得る。未登録peerはsourceとtargetで異なる。

expected.en: The destination has exactly the selected values and shape, including the chosen high bits or signed/wide key membership; stale associative entries disappear where applicable.
expected.ja: 宛先は選択値と形状を正確に保持し、選択high bitまたはsigned／wide key所属を含む。該当時は古い連想entryがなくなる。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values and one-dimensional shapes only. Packing, printing, recording, configuration, all empty/invalid shapes, alias graphs and concurrent mutation remain partial. Copy and comparison observations share one fixture and are not independent test counts.
limitations.ja: 選択two-state値と1次元形状だけ。pack、print、record、configuration、全empty／invalid形状、alias graph、並行変更は部分的に残る。copyと比較観測は1 fixtureを共有し独立テスト数ではない。

statement.en: The selected int aa_integral field macro compares copied equal data successfully.
statement.ja: 選択int aa_integral field macroはcopy後の等値dataを等しいと比較する。

expected.ja: 未登録peer propertyが異なってもcopy後のsource／targetは等しいと比較する。

limitations.en: Selected two-state values and one-dimensional shapes only. Packing, printing, recording, configuration, all empty/invalid shapes, alias graphs and concurrent mutation remain partial. Copy and comparison observations share one fixture and are not independent test counts.

statement.ja: 既定recording macroは選択した名前／値とmetadataを宣言されたrecorder interfaceへ渡す。

Keep a separate peer recorder. Set the recorder default radix to UVM_BIN but explicitly request UVM_HEX for a thirty-three-bit value; retain the declared record_field backend route.

expected.en: The selected original recording hook receives the exact value/name and applicable size/radix or required generic conversion, preserving the other recorder.
expected.ja: 選択した独自recording hookは正確な値／名前と該当size／radixまたは要求generic変換を受け、他recorderを保持する。

statement.en: A direct small-width record_field call reaches its specified field backend hook.
statement.ja: 小さい幅の直接record_field呼出しは指定されたfield backend hookへ届く。

conditions.en: A valid transaction recorder, original field/int hooks and a thirty-three-bit value. Select UVM_BIN as the configured default and observe omitted radix and explicit UVM_HEX in separate counter windows.
conditions.ja: 有効transaction recorder、独自field／int hook、33-bit値を使う。設定既定値にUVM_BINを選び、radix省略と明示UVM_HEXを別counter区間で観測する。

expected.en: Both calls preserve name/value/width and use the field hook rather than the int hook; omitted radix can retain the marker or resolve to the configured default, while explicit HEX is retained.
expected.ja: 両呼出しは名前／値／幅を保ち、intではなくfield hookを使う。省略radixは未指定印または設定既定値を使え、明示HEXは保持する。

limitations.en: A public API control is a different premise from a recording macro. Selected thirty-three-bit/default/explicit conditions do not certify all field widths or recording lifecycles.
limitations.ja: 公開API controlはrecording macroとは異なる前提であり、選択33-bit／既定／明示条件で全field幅や記録lifecycleを認定しない。

expected.en: The exact typed visitor and object base views identify the same subtype, and one visit delivers the original selected node once.
expected.ja: 正確な型付きvisitorとobjectの基底viewは同じ派生型を識別し、1回のvisitで元の選択nodeを1回渡す。

statement.en: Before processing fields, object unpacking assigns policy state using the matching stream-type method.
statement.ja: object unpackはfieldの処理前に、対応するstream型のmethodでpolicy状態を設定する。

conditions.en: Same unchanged original subject class; explicit packer subtypes A/B/A and eight-bit payloads 11/22/33 hexadecimal, separately for bit/byte/int/longint streams. Observer flags identify the selected hook and typed state method, with monotonic original callback ticks recording the selected order.
conditions.ja: 同じ未変更の独自subject classを使い、明示packer派生型A／B／Aと8 bit payload 16進11／22／33をbit／byte／int／longint stream別に扱う。observer flagで選択hookと型付き状態methodを識別し、独自callbackの単調tickで選択順序を記録する。

expected.en: The matching setter is called before the custom field unpacking hook, and the selected original value is restored.
expected.ja: 対応するsetterが独自field unpack hookの前に呼ばれ、選択した元の値が戻る。

limitations.en: Selected two-state scalar and explicit-policy cases only. State encoding/array lengths remain opaque. Each stream is produced and consumed through the same compatible policy instance and stream type; the roundtrip is a data guard, not independent codec proof or arbitrary cross-policy compatibility. No nested/default/null, field automation, four-state or complete packing coverage is claimed.
limitations.ja: 選択した2値scalarと明示policy条件だけ。状態の符号化と配列長は不透明のままにし、同じ互換policy instanceと同じstream型で生成・消費する。往復はdata guardであり、独立codecの証明や任意policy間互換ではない。入れ子／既定／null、field automation、4値、全packing coverageは主張しない。

conditions.en: Two fields use distinct caller-supplied textual name/type/size/value attributes through print_generic_element. Actual table/tree/line printers each exercise all eight name/type/size masks. One path sets controls before object sprint; another collects under the opposite mask and changes controls only before emit. Reuse changes values and checks an independent fresh peer policy. Default-peer inputs retain their omitted-setting premise. Four separately named tree/line controls explicitly enable peer settings; their matches cannot pass the default-peer inputs.

expected.en: Both supplied attributes are present when enabled and both absent when disabled, even after collection; current values remain and prior values are absent, while the independent peer keeps its enabled defaults.

limitations.en: Selected two-state, short textual generic-element attributes only. Strings isolate visibility from numeric size conversion. statement.en: When configured for a driver requiring a particular sequence base, the adapter parent_sequence supplies that required context for its bus items.
statement.ja: 特定sequence基底を要求するdriver向けに設定したadapterのparent_sequenceは、bus itemへその要求contextを供給する。

conditions.en: Original one-byte numeric-word frontdoors independently exercise register/memory reads/writes with no caller parent. Required-parent subtypes alternate A/B/A and current original tags 17/34/51. Paired inputs concurrently exercise two separate adapter/map/sequencer/driver routes; the peer retains base B/tag 119. A user clone override calls an original do_clone bridge; reads use independently seeded storage.
conditions.ja: caller parentなしの独自1-byte数値word frontdoorで、register／memoryのread／writeを独立に扱う。要求parent派生型はA／B／Aと切り替え、独自の現在tagは17／34／51とする。paired入力は別のadapter／map／sequencer／driver 2経路を並行実行し、peerは基底B／tag 119を保持する。user clone overrideが独自do_clone bridgeを呼び、read用storageは独立に事前設定する。

expected.en: The actual driver sees each required sequence base and the current fixture tag, completes the request successfully and transfers the selected byte. Both paired routes retain their independently selected contexts without imposing completion order.
expected.ja: 実driverは各要求sequence基底と検査系の現在tagを受け、要求を成功完了し選択byteを転送する。paired両経路は独立した選択contextを保持し、完了順は規定しない。

limitations.en: Selected two-state, single-byte, caller-parent-omitted conditions only. The printed clause does not specify a do_clone prototype; the original bridge defines fixture behavior, not an inferred standard API. No clone count/identity, generated name, arbitrary base-state copy, separate response, external RTL, endian/partial-width or full adapter correctness is established. Interactions with explicit caller-parent child rules in register/memory access clauses remain a separate open review; the adapter rule is not assumed to override them. Predictor check_phase and its unspecified diagnostic severity remain unassessed.
limitations.ja: 選択した2値・単一byte・caller parent省略条件だけ。記載条項はdo_cloneのprototypeを示さず、独自bridgeは検査系の動作を定義し、推測した標準APIではない。clone件数／同一性、生成名、任意の基底状態copy、別response、外部RTL、endian／部分幅、全adapter動作は成立させない。register／memoryアクセス条項の明示caller-parentのchild規則との組合せは別の未完レビューとし、adapter規則がそれらを上書きするとは仮定しない。predictor check_phaseと未規定の診断severityは未評価に残す。

statement.en: HDL force reports one for a successful operation and zero when the call fails.
statement.ja: HDL forceは成功時に1、呼出し失敗時に0を返す。

conditions.en: Actual public forceable 8/40-bit reg and wire signals, one independent unforced peer, opposing procedural assignments or changed continuous drivers, plain release or immediate release-and-read, and missing/uninstrumented failure targets. Public VPI force/release flags implement the separately fingerprinted backend; ordinary runs do not link it.
conditions.ja: 実際の公開forceableな8／40-bit regとwire、独立した未force peer、反対値への手続き代入または連続driver変更、通常releaseまたは即時release-and-read、存在しない／未instrumentの失敗targetを使う。公開VPI force／release flagによるbackendを別の指紋で識別し、通常実行ではlinkしない。

expected.en: Instrumented valid paths return one; missing/uninstrumented paths return zero and the independent valid control succeeds.
expected.ja: instrument済み有効pathは1、存在しない／未instrument pathは0を返し、独立した有効controlは成功する。

limitations.en: Selected two-state packed scalar signals up to 64 bits with forceable instrumentation only. Settled force observations do not certify every delta-cycle update; release-and-read observations check the returned value immediately. No general array/select/user-nettype, force_time positive-duration, four-state, vendor overlay, permissions or complete HDL coverage is established. Failure output buffers, exact diagnostics and general rollback are unspecified here. Unsupported target failures are a declared backend condition, not a normative exclusion.
limitations.ja: forceableのinstrumentationを付けた64 bit以下の選択2値packed scalar信号だけ。安定後のforce観測で全delta-cycle更新を認定せず、release-and-readは戻り直後の値を検査する。一般array／select／user nettype、正時間force_time、4値、vendor overlay、権限、完全なHDL検査は成立させない。失敗時の出力buffer、正確な診断、一般rollbackはここでは規定しない。非対応targetの失敗は宣言したbackend条件であり、規範的な除外ではない。

limitations.en: Selected two-state packed scalar signals up to 64 bits with forceable instrumentation only. statement.en: Using an unregistered object/callback type pair through add or delete issues a warning.
statement.ja: 未登録のobject／callback型pairをaddまたはdeleteで使うとwarningを発行する。

conditions.en: Original legal object/callback derivatives use actual registration and implicit dispatch macros. Cases include global/class-local aliases of parameterized callbacks, shared handles in separate instance queues, explicit mode0/1, related/unrelated callback families, inherited typewide state and completed-call reconfiguration. METHOD receives original object/token and mutable reference arguments. No factory-utility prerequisite is added.
conditions.ja: 独自の合法object／callback派生型で実登録macroと暗黙dispatch macroを使う。parameterized callbackのglobal／class-local alias、別instance queueで共有するhandle、明示mode0／1、関連／無関係callback型、継承typewide状態、呼出し完了後の再設定を含む。METHODは元のobject／tokenと変更可能な参照引数を受ける。factory utilityの前提は追加しない。

expected.en: Fresh instance and typewide add/delete windows each observe at least one WARNING without fixing its text,count or queue outcome.
expected.ja: 新規instance／typewideのadd／delete windowで少なくとも1つのWARNINGを観測し、text／件数／queue結果を固定しない。

limitations.en: Selected callback dispatch/diagnostic conditions only. Original affine arithmetic and traces expose ordered reference propagation,not a UVM algorithm. Unregistered warning windows assert presence without a diagnostic ID,text or exact count,and do not prescribe acceptance,membership or recovery. Empty-delete warning presence alone does not identify the validation mechanism. Typedef usability does not establish private registration bits or general absence of warnings. No active-iteration mutation,unspecified cross-queue order,omitted callback-mode default or complete type/hierarchy/lifecycle coverage is certified. The B.4 overview base-type wording remains unresolved despite the partial operational decomposition.

statement.en: An empty calling-object context supplies no callbacks to the implicit macro.

conditions.en: Original legal object/callback derivatives use actual registration and implicit dispatch macros. Cases include global/class-local aliases of parameterized callbacks, shared handles in separate instance queues, explicit mode0/1, related/unrelated callback families, inherited typewide state and completed-call reconfiguration. METHOD receives original object/token and mutable reference arguments. No factory-utility prerequisite is added.
conditions.ja: 独自の合法object／callback派生型で実登録macroと暗黙dispatch macroを使う。parameterized callbackのglobal／class-local alias、別instance queueで共有するhandle、明示mode0／1、関連／無関係callback型、継承typewide状態、呼出し完了後の再設定を含む。METHODは元のobject／tokenと変更可能な参照引数を受ける。factory utilityの前提は追加しない。

expected.en: The selected empty caller is entered,reference sentinels are retained and a peer-only callback is not called.
expected.ja: 選択した空callerへ進入し、参照sentinelを保持してpeer専用callbackを呼ばない。

limitations.en: Selected callback dispatch/diagnostic conditions only. Original affine arithmetic and traces expose ordered reference propagation,not a UVM algorithm. Unregistered warning windows assert presence without a diagnostic ID,text or exact count,and do not prescribe acceptance,membership or recovery. Empty-delete warning presence alone does not identify the validation mechanism. Typedef usability does not establish private registration bits or general absence of warnings. No active-iteration mutation,unspecified cross-queue order,omitted callback-mode default or complete type/hierarchy/lifecycle coverage is certified. The B.4 overview base-type wording remains unresolved despite the partial operational decomposition.
limitations.ja: 選択したcallback dispatch／診断条件のみ。独自のaffine計算とtraceで順序付きの参照伝播を観測し、UVM algorithmにはしない。未登録のwarning windowはID／text／正確な件数なしに存在だけを要求し、受理／所属／復旧を規定しない。空queueのdelete warningの存在だけでは検証機構を特定しない。typedefの利用可能性で非公開登録bitや一般的なwarning不在を成立させない。反復中の変更、未指定のqueue間順序、callback-mode省略既定値、型／階層／寿命の完全性は認定しない。B.4導入の基底型本文は分類で消さず未解決に保持する。

conditions.en: Unmodified public UVM types/macros and default packer implementation. Flag overrides use the actual reserved-count parameter plus17 or129,without fixing its implementation-dependent value. Capacity inputs explicitly flush and retain32768 bits via independent original8/64-bit payload patterns. Version inputs use public package/preprocessor access;the illegal parameter assignment has no runtime.
conditions.ja: 公開UVM型／macroと未変更の既定packer実装を使う。flagの上書きは実reserved-count parameterに17または129を加え、実装依存の数値を固定しない。容量入力は明示flush後、独自の8／64-bit値patternで32768 bitを保持する。version入力は公開package／preprocessor参照を使い、不正parameter代入はruntimeを実行しない。

limitations.en: Selected declarations,bit extents and necessary observations only. No reserved numeric value/lower-bit encoding,universal field-operation behavior,vendor version spelling or complete historical revision ladder is prescribed. Nonempty version text is a necessary observable,not proof of accurate implementation identification. Capacity retention does not prescribe stream length/encoding,allocation strategy or maximum capacity;the macro-presence duty remains separate. These two-state observations do not certify X/Z behavior or all scope/milestone obligations. No implementation source or commercial result defines the oracle.

conditions.en: Read-write memory and statically configured three-element virtual arrays use explicit memory-word offsets and strides. Each original fixture independently seeds all 32 words, selects indices 0 and 2, and repeats the operation with omitted debug arguments, a named file/positive line, and another file/negative line. Singleword profiles use 8-bit or 16-bit memory/register widths and 4-bit or 9-bit fields. Two 16-bit-word profiles add a 32-bit whole register or a 16-bit field at LSB 8. Original user backdoor storage and actual public 16-bit HDL array storage are separate execution conditions. Fields are created through type_id::create.

statement.en: The filename and line-number debug arguments have no functional effect on virtual-field poke.
statement.ja: file名と行番号のdebug引数はvirtual fieldのpokeの機能上の結果へ影響しない。

conditions.en: Read-write memory and statically configured three-element virtual arrays use explicit memory-word offsets and strides. Each original fixture independently seeds all 32 words, selects indices 0 and 2, and repeats the operation with omitted debug arguments, a named file/positive line, and another file/negative line. Singleword profiles use 8-bit or 16-bit memory/register widths and 4-bit or 9-bit fields. Two 16-bit-word profiles add a 32-bit whole register or a 16-bit field at LSB 8. Original user backdoor storage and actual public 16-bit HDL array storage are separate execution conditions. Fields are created through type_id::create.
conditions.ja: read-write memoryと静的に設定した3要素のvirtual配列は、memory word単位のoffsetとstrideを明示する。独自検査系は全32 wordを独立に初期化し、index 0と2を選び、debug引数省略、file名と正の行番号、別file名と負の行番号で操作を繰り返す。単一word条件はmemory／register幅8／16 bitとfield幅4／9 bitを使い、16-bit wordを2つ使う条件は32-bit全registerまたはLSB 8の16-bit fieldを加える。独自user backdoor記憶域と実公開16-bit HDL array記憶域は別の実行条件にし、fieldはtype_id::createで生成する。

expected.en: Omitted/default debug arguments and two explicit file/line variants each satisfy the same independently derived status, data and storage-preservation predicates.
expected.ja: 省略／default debug引数と2種類の明示file／行番号が、それぞれ同じ独立に導いたstatus、data、記憶域保持の判定を満たす。

limitations.en: Selected successful operations only; read-only/other policies, dynamic relocation, failed-access outputs, concurrency, callbacks, parent/extension forwarding and reset-semaphore recovery remain open. Exact field replacement is checked within a single word. Multiword whole values have equal halves; poke of a field spanning two words accepts either order of its independently derived two-word result, and peek of that field uses equal halves. These are necessary layout-independent observations, not a unique word-order contract or full software/hardware layout agreement. Untouched raw words are observed directly; no exact internal access count/order, selected-call membership restriction, unused upper output bits, four-state behavior or bus/DUT protocol is prescribed. Model storage matches do not prove physical HDL access, and HDL matches do not pass an unlinked ordinary condition. Expected lines can combine distinct predicates; ledger anchor membership alone does not certify repetitions or ordering. All reviews are AI, with no implementation-derived or commercial-result oracle.
limitations.ja: 選択した成功操作のみ。read-onlyなど他のpolicy、動的再配置、失敗時出力、並行処理、callback、parent／extension転送、resetによるsemaphore回復は未完。正確なfield置換は単一word内で検査する。複数wordの全register値は両半分を同じにし、境界をまたぐpokeは独立に導いた2 wordのどちらの順序も許し、peekは同じ半分を使う。これは配置順に依存しない必要な観測で、word順序の一意な契約やsoftware／hardware間の配置合意全体ではない。非対象raw wordを直接観測し、内部access回数／順序、選択呼出しの所属制限、未使用の上位出力bit、4-state、bus／DUT protocolは規定しない。model記憶域の一致で物理HDL accessを立証せず、HDL一致で通常の未link条件を成功扱いにしない。期待行は別の判定を合わせた場合があり、台帳anchorの所属確認だけでは繰返しや順序を認定しない。照合はすべてAIで、実装由来や商用結果のoracleは使わない。

statement.en: A virtual-register pre_write method can replace the value subsequently deposited by that write.
statement.ja: virtual registerのpre_write methodで変更した値を、後続のwriteがdepositする。

conditions.en: Original 16-bit memory-backed virtual registers have one 4-bit field at LSB4 and selected indices0/2 of a static three-element array. Two healthy map-specific original frontdoors and one original user backdoor contain different independently seeded16-bit words. Each index first reads all three routes with edits disabled. Actual virtual/registered callbacks then edit one selected data/path/map/status or record first/last events for the selected read/write kind. Memory callbacks of the other kind are outside those ordering predicates. Parent-register and standalone-field calls are distinct inputs. No real HDL, bus driver or protocol implementation is involved.
conditions.ja: 独自の16-bit memory上のvirtual registerへLSB4の4-bit fieldを1つ設定し、静的3要素配列のindex0／2を選ぶ。正常なmap別の独自frontdoor 2系統とuser backdoor 1系統に異なる16-bit wordを独立に初期化し、各indexで変更を無効にした3経路のreadを先に確認する。その後、実virtual／登録callbackが選択したdata／path／map／statusを変更するか、選択read／write種別の最初／最後のeventを記録する。他種別のmemory callbackをその順序判定へ混ぜず、親registerとfield単独の呼出しは別入力にする。実HDL、bus driver、protocol実装は扱わない。

expected.en: A virtual-register pre_write method can replace the value subsequently deposited by that write.
expected.ja: virtual registerのpre_write methodで変更した値を、後続のwriteがdepositする。

limitations.en: AI partial decomposition only. Aggregate expected rows contain multiple predicates and do not independently assign per-duty execution status. Ordering is checked through first/last relationships without exact internal transfer/callback counts or order between independent fields. The qualified pre-read probes keep incompatible grouping readings separate: register hooks after all field hooks versus field method/facade after containing-register hooks. The latter reading includes both the containing virtual method and registered facade, with explicit interpretation review still open. No erratum, root cause or independent-defect count follows from a mismatch. Failure-origin callbacks, competing edits, disabled/multiple callbacks, concurrency, killed-access reset recovery, other policies/maps/widths, complete declaration/default-body coverage and original milestone targets remain open. Modified post-read data/status do not change the raw modeled banks. No implementation source or commercial result supplies the oracle.
limitations.ja: AIによる部分分解のみ。期待行は複数の判定を含み、義務ごとの実行statusを独立に認定しない。内部transfer／callbackの正確な回数や独立field間の順序を固定せず、最初／最後の関係を検査する。限定したpre-read入力は、register hookが全field hookより後という解釈と、field method／facadeが親register hookより後という両立しない整理の解釈を分ける。後者は親のvirtual methodと登録facadeの両方を含む読みで、解釈の照合は未完。不一致から訂正、根本原因、独立した欠陥件数を認定しない。失敗を起点とするcallback、競合する変更、無効／複数callback、並行処理、kill中accessのreset回復、他のpolicy／map／幅、宣言／既定body全体、元のmilestone目標は未完。post-readのdata／status変更でraw model bankは変わらない。実装sourceや商用結果をoracleにしない。

statement.en: Under the historical fresh-space reading,GREEDY avoids the released block while never-before-reserved space is available.

conditions.en: Explicit historical interpretation. In each of eight fresh32-location one-byte managers,a live4-location region remains reserved while another low/high4-location region is reserved and released. A default-policy4-location request follows. The qualified GREEDY reading consumes never-before-reserved space when available;the THRIFTY reading maximizes reuse of the released block. Per-request bounds,width,disjointness,held-region endpoints/membership and cleanup are checked without private history state.
conditions.ja: 歴史的な意味を明示解釈する。1-byte location 32個の新managerを8回作り、有効な4-location regionを予約したまま、下位／上位の別4-location regionを予約・解放する。続いて既定policyで4-locationを要求する。限定したGREEDY解釈は利用可能なら予約歴のない領域を使い、THRIFTY解釈は解放blockの再利用を最大にする。各requestの境界、幅、非重複、保持regionの端点／所属、cleanupをprivate履歴なしに確認する。

expected.en: Every selected request is valid and meets its stated fresh/reuse preference while held regions remain unchanged and allocated until explicitly released.
expected.ja: 選択した全requestが有効で記載した新規／再利用の選好を満たし、保持regionは明示解放まで変更されず割り当てられたままである。

statement.en: A phase node supplies a distinct instance context within its containing schedule.

conditions.en: Two independent original inputs create topdown/bottomup IMP objects and nodes in two schedules. They capture each isolated schedule node before joining both schedules to the component domain,then check types,parent/domain identities and manual selected-subtree traversal. Original post-attachment lookup inputs remain separate controls for the stricter scope interpretation.
conditions.ja: 独立した独自2入力でtopdown／bottomupのIMP objectと、2 schedule内のnodeを作る。両scheduleをcomponent domainへ接続する前に各独立scheduleのnodeを取得し、その後の型、parent／domainの同一性、選択subtreeの手動走査を調べる。接続後lookupの元入力は、より厳しいscope解釈の別controlとして残す。

expected.en: Prescoped nodes for the repeated implementation have distinct handles and selected parent schedules;manual dispatch receives the selected node handle.
expected.ja: 反復する実装のprescoped nodeは異なるhandleと選択parent scheduleを持ち、手動dispatchは選択node handleを受け取る。

limitations.en: AI partial decomposition only. Expected anchors do not independently assign measured status to every duty. A separate control or another setup cannot pass an original differing whole input. Human review,scope/denominator approval,all applicability and original M1-M4 targets remain open. No numeric encoding,exact sibling order,get_imp wording,automatic scheduling,all state transitions or parallel domain execution is certified. Repeated-IMP lookup within a shared domain remains a qualified separate duty. Only the type-designator duty reuses an unchanged constructor input;that link adds no execution or primary focus.
limitations.ja: AIによる部分分解のみ。期待anchorは各義務へ独立した実測statusを割り当てない。別controlや他の準備で元の差分入力全体をpassにしない。人の照合、範囲／分母承認、全適用条件、元のM1〜M4目標は未完。 数値encoding、正確な兄弟順序、get_impの文言、自動schedule、全状態遷移、domainの並列実行は認定しない。共有domain内の反復IMP lookupは限定した別義務として残す。型識別子の義務だけが未変更constructor入力を再利用し、そのlinkで実行や主引用を増やさない。

statement.en: The selected packing macro preserves its integral collection as data recoverable by the corresponding macro with a compatible packer.
statement.ja: 選択packing macroはintegral collectionを、互換packerと対応macroで復元できるdataとして保持する。

conditions.en: Use original do_pack/do_unpack overrides with a nonempty, pre-sized sarray of two or four unsigned elements. N is a positive constant 9 or 97 with 109-bit storage and an independently set high bit outside the selected width. Static-array cases use distinct nonzero ascending/descending index ranges. Packing-focused paired inputs decode on the same policy; unpacking-focused paired inputs transfer untouched get_packed_bits state into set_packed_bits of a fresh identically typed compatible policy. Separate static-array inputs also retain qualified one-way scalar-API probes. All inputs carry an independent seven-bit trailer and separate object/policy peers.
conditions.ja: 独自do_pack／do_unpack overrideを使い、2または4 unsigned要素を持つ空でない事前サイズ設定済みstatic arrayを使う。Nは正の定数9または97で、109-bit記憶域の選択幅外の上位bitも独立に設定する。 static arrayは非zeroの昇順／降順index範囲を使う。packing中心のpaired入力は同一policyでdecodeし、unpacking中心のpaired入力はget_packed_bitsの状態を解釈も変更もせずfreshで同じ型の互換policyのset_packed_bitsへ渡す。別のstatic-array入力は限定した片方向scalar-API probeも保持する。全入力に独立した7-bit trailerと別object／policy peerを用意する。

expected.en: Each restored element equals its independently chosen value and the pre-sized shape is retained. The selected trailer remains and is consumed independently; source values, unrelated fields and peer state remain intact. Opaque-state consumers do not consume the original source packer. Static one-way probes additionally compare the corresponding scalar API.
expected.ja: 各復元要素が独立に選んだ値に一致し、事前サイズ設定したshapeを保持する。選択trailerを残して独立に消費し、source値、無関係なfield、peer状態を保持する。opaque状態のconsumerは元のsource packerを消費しない。staticの片方向probeでは対応するscalar APIとの比較も行う。

limitations.en: AI partial decomposition only. Paired restoration does not independently prove each one-way implementation or exclude mutually compensating encoder/decoder defects; static scalar-API probes retain an explicitly qualified interoperability interpretation. The collection clauses do not promise element-only primitive framing. Separately IEEE16.5.3.1/.2 leaves exported state length/format unspecified and defines matched opaque typed transfer. No flat/no-header or mandatory length-header grammar is prescribed. No external raw order, automatic allocation, empty/differently-sized containers, signed/XZ semantics, alternate policy, invalid/nonconstant/zero/negative N diagnostics, all failure cases or concurrency is certified. Expected anchors are not measured passes. All remaining applicability, original M1-M4 targets, human review and scope/denominator approval remain open.

statement.en: Selected implementation-declaration macro invocations in separate packages create distinct generated class types even with identical suffix arguments.
statement.ja: 別package内の選択implementation宣言macroは、同じsuffix引数でも異なる生成class型を作る。

conditions.en: Use two original lexical packages, each declaring blocking-put and nonblocking-get classes for both _shared96 and plain96 suffixes. Actual connected ordinary ports resolve generated imps owned by two original components; reverse owner-component construction and selected call order, use default/indexed interface views and int/class transaction types.

expected.en: The exact generated class names are usable with supplied suffix spelling; interface views retain selected imp/parent identity, and cross-package or cross-suffix downcasts fail. Independently selected handlers retain actual argument/output histories.
expected.ja: 指定したsuffix綴りの正確な生成class名を使え、interface viewが選択imp／parent同一性を保持し、package間／suffix間のdowncastは失敗する。独立に選んだhandlerが実際の引数／出力履歴を保持する。

limitations.en: AI partial decomposition for two declaration families and suffix forms only. Generic uvm_interface_imp_decl wording denotes a family placeholder, not a separate mandatory macro or class. Suffixed handler spelling follows the established selected-interface test profile; no universal concrete get_type_name string, failed-output value, all interface combinations, builtin duplicate-method diagnosis, arbitrary connection topology or complete TLM protocol is asserted. This does not settle every B.5 obligation or original M1-M4 target. No human review or scope/denominator approval.
